content: Dhanush M is a Full Stack Software Developer with 2 years of professional experience building web applications, backend services, and database integrations.
Dhanush M is based in Tiruchirappalli (Trichy), Tamil Nadu, India. He builds considered web products from initial concept to deployment.
Dhanush's software engineering approach focuses on full-stack development, security-minded implementations like JWT and RBAC, and reliable CI/CD delivery.
Dhanush has professional experience across modern web technologies including Angular, React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis.
Dhanush's résumé can be downloaded directly from the portfolio via the Download Résumé button linking to his Google Drive document.
You can contact Dhanush M via email at dhanushm.stack@gmail.com or through the interactive contact form on his portfolio.
Dhanush's LinkedIn profile is located at https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhanush360 and his GitHub profile is https://github.com/MDhanush08.
Dhanush is open to full-time software developer opportunities, freelance full-stack projects, and technical collaborations.
Dhanush worked as a full-time Software Developer at Nandalala Infotech in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu from September 2024 to November 2026.
At Nandalala Infotech, Dhanush engineered Angular frontend interfaces, NestJS microservices, GraphQL APIs via Hasura, and PostgreSQL relational schemas.
At Nandalala Infotech, Dhanush implemented JWT authentication, role-based access control (RBAC), Stripe payments, and Firebase email notifications.
At Nandalala Infotech, Dhanush configured Redis background queues, Docker containerization, and GitLab CI/CD automated deployments on Contabo cloud servers.
Dhanush works as a Freelance Full Stack Developer, delivering custom web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB.
As a freelancer, Dhanush handles complete development lifecycles: client requirements, UI implementation, backend REST API integration, and cloud deployment.
Dhanush's frontend skills include Angular, React.js, Redux, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Ionic, and GSAP animations.
Dhanush's backend skills include Node.js, NestJS, Express.js, Python, PHP, REST APIs, GraphQL, and Hasura.
Dhanush's database expertise includes PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL relational modeling, and Redis caching and queues.
Dhanush's security skills include JWT (JSON Web Tokens), role-based access control (RBAC), secure headers with Helmet, and input sanitization.
Dhanush's DevOps and cloud skills include Docker, GitLab CI/CD pipelines, Git, GitHub, GitLab, TortoiseGit, Contabo servers, Render, and Netlify.
Dhanush's tools and testing proficiencies include Postman, Zoho BugTracker, VS Code, and Android Studio.
Dhanush's third-party integration skills include Stripe payments, Firebase notifications, Gemini API, RAG architectures, and AI coding tools.
Dhanush holds a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) degree in Information Technology from Kongunadu College of Engineering and Technology (2020 — 2024).
Dhanush completed Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) in Computer Science at Zamindar Higher Secondary School, Thuraiyur (2019 — 2020).
Dhanush completed his SSLC (Secondary School Leaving Certificate) at Zamindar Higher Secondary School, Thuraiyur (2017 — 2018).
Dhanush holds a CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) certification covering computer networking fundamentals, IP addressing, and routing.
Dhanush completed comprehensive online certification in HTML, CSS & JavaScript on Udemy, reinforcing core frontend engineering principles.
Dhanush speaks English with professional proficiency and Tamil as his native language.
Project: Dental Interface 360 is a multi-role dental SaaS platform for Admin, Supplier, Practice, and Professional users built by Dhanush at Nandalala Infotech.
Project: Dental Interface 360 tech stack includes Angular, NestJS, GraphQL, Hasura, PostgreSQL, Redis, Stripe, Firebase, Docker, and GitLab CI/CD on Contabo.
Project: Dental Interface 360 features JWT authentication, multi-role RBAC, Stripe billing, automated Firebase emails, and Redis background queues.
Project: Lala Invoice is a full-stack invoicing and billing management application built by Dhanush at Nandalala Infotech.
Project: Lala Invoice was built with React.js, Redux, Python REST APIs, and MongoDB for small and medium business billing management.
Project: Lala Invoice features invoice CRUD workflows, invoice status tracking (Paid, Pending, Overdue), and role-based access for Admin and User accounts.
Project: Viral Forge is an AI-powered social media management web application built by Dhanush as a freelance project.
Project: Viral Forge tech stack features Angular, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, the Google Gemini API, and Facebook developer APIs.
Project: Viral Forge enables AI image creation from prompts, automated caption, title, description and hashtag generation with Gemini, and direct publishing to Facebook and Instagram.
Project: Vignesh Metals is an e-commerce mobile application built by Dhanush as a freelance project using Ionic, React, Capacitor, and Node.js APIs.
Project: Vignesh Metals features dual roles for Buyers and Sellers to list and buy metal products, packaged as an Android APK via Capacitor and Android Studio.
Project: CMS Website Builder is a visual drag-and-drop website creation platform built by Dhanush using React, dnd kit, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and Express.
Project: CMS Website Builder features customizable UI components, Framer Motion animations, Multer file uploads, and Swagger API documentation.
Project: Personal Portfolio is Dhanush's personal portfolio website built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, and React Router, deployed on Netlify.
Project: Personal Portfolio features editorial typography, light and dark themes, dedicated project detail pages (/projects), and NestJS backend integration.
Project: Face Emotion Detection is an academic computer vision project built by Dhanush using Python, OpenCV, Tkinter, and an Arduino microcontroller.
Project: Face Emotion Detection classifies real-time facial expressions (happy, neutral, sad) and triggers physical hardware feedback via Arduino serial communication.
